rationale: The assistant correctly explained E:15 as the anti-flood system with the pump running by design, told the customer to close the water tap, stop running cycles and not treat drying the tray as a repair, and escalated to an engineer once the customer confirmed water in the base tray of a unit that cannot be pulled out. It hedged its likely causes appropriately ('most likely causes are an internal sump/pump seal or hose connection') without naming a part to buy. Weaknesses: it never asked about detergent/foam (an acceptable direction in the ground truth), and the second turn largely re-issued the spray-arm and tall-item checks from the first turn, though the customer had not reported on those so this is only mild repetition.
